natural_error_semantics: Natural parser errors are exact retained errors projected into manually authored observations; these are not naturally observed extractor errors.
source_text_semantics: Unmodified retained parser-text spans joined by two newlines; reviewer-selected context, not automated retrieval. Complete output supplied for original-document absence challenge.

label_conventions.support: Entailment by supplied text; explicit false certainty loses support. No image/reference rescue.
label_conventions.role: Whether candidate assigns evidence to the correct semantic slot; ambiguous/displaced slot is insufficient.
label_conventions.condition: Preserved includes no applicable condition; omitted_or_changed only for relevant qualification/condition.
label_conventions.conflict: Relevant source disagreement, not merely candidate contradiction or unrelated conflict.

same_parser_blindspot: C003 should be text-supported despite incorrect original-PDF email. Never count rejection as successful semantic recovery without independent evidence; report source-fidelity limitation separately.
scope_limitations: No fresh evaluation, random sampling, statistical independence or national generalization.
Excerpts are reviewer-scoped to the named notice; target segmentation is not evaluated.
